description:
About the company
 Our client is a fast-growing technology company.
 The role
 Raydar is recruiting for this role on behalf of our client. Develop and maintain server-side services, APIs and data workflows for a multi-product software platform. Collaborate with research and engineering colleagues to keep infrastructure reliable as usage grows, taking projects from early concept to live production.
 What you'll do
 - Develop dependable server-side services and data workflows that support several products.
 - Plan infrastructure that stays efficient as usage expands.
 - Contribute across external-facing, research-facing and internal tooling applications.
 - Work with research colleagues to refine the systems that gather their data.
 - Maintain APIs and services relied on by a large daily user population.
 Requirements 
 What we're looking for
 - At least 2 years of backend engineering experience.
 - Proficiency in Python and TypeScript.
 - Background in a fast-moving startup rather than solely large, established organizations.
 - History of taking new initiatives from nothing to launch and showing clear business results.
 - Hands-on experience operating data-heavy services in a live environment.
 - A computer science degree from a strong program, or equivalent experience.
 Bonus points
 - Domain experience in audio, machine learning or data infrastructure.
 - Familiarity with Node.js, PostgreSQL or AWS.
 Benefits 
 Compensation and benefits
 - Base salary: USD 175,000 to 225,000 per year
 - Equity
 - Unlimited paid time off
 - Health, dental and vision coverage
 - Retirement plan
 - FSA and HSA access
 Location and work model
 - San Francisco, CA, United States
 - On-site, 5 days per week in office
 - Full-time
